blocks.text:
These days are devoted to time by the sea.

Búzios has sheltered bays with calm water and open ocean beaches with waves and wind. You can try different beaches in a single day.

If you wish, hire a buggy to explore the peninsula's beaches or take a sailing trip with stops for swimming.

You can also spend the beach section of your trip at another resort. One alternative is Angra dos Reis, about 155 km south of Rio de Janeiro.

Other options are the resorts of north-eastern Brazil, usually a flight of about 2–3 hours from Rio: Porto de Galinhas, Pipa, Salvador, Jericoacoara, Aquiraz, Porto Seguro and Trancoso. These places suit travellers who want to spend their final days on long tropical beaches with clear water.
